description: Small deterministic coding tasks. Benchmark score is based on passing the existing fixture tests without modifying them.

tasks.task: Implement normalize_spaces(value: str) in strings.py so it trims leading/trailing whitespace and collapses every run of whitespace to one ASCII space. Preserve the empty-string result for empty or whitespace-only input. Do not modify tests or unrelated files.

Implement clamp(value, low, high) in math_utils.py. Return low when value is below low, high when above high, and value otherwise. Raise ValueError when low > high. Do not modify tests or unrelated files.

Fix word_count(text) in text_stats.py to count non-empty words separated by arbitrary whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines); empty or whitespace-only text must return zero. Do not modify tests or unrelated files.
